hypothesis: A single completed close beyond the SMA Bollinger band may give timely long/short breakouts; test adjacent SMA lengths, band widths and one/two-close confirmations across all cached instruments and 1H/4H/1D/1W.
parameter_rationale: SMA length 20 is the user rule; 30 probes nearby slower bands. Widths 1.5/2/2.5 standard deviations and 1/2 completed closes test entry sensitivity without a huge opportunistic grid.
baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on the same stock and timeframe, filled next open
signal_rule: Compute SMA and population standard deviation on completed bars. After a close crosses above the upper band from inside, require 1 or 2 consecutive closes above and signal long exactly once; symmetric lower-band crossing signals short. Opposite signal reverses. Execute at next bar open. Do not draw or trade on unfinished bars.
cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
selection: Rank fixed variants using early months; latest 12m after-cost gate >10% per liquid stock; already seen late history is not holdout.
limitations: Source is user-designed, not an attributed Bollinger method
No dividends or splits in main result
Pine compilation and fill-by-fill parity pending

research_provenance.source: User-specified Pine rule in this conversation, 2026-11-14
research_provenance.note: Different from bollinger-confirmed-breakout: no middle-band exit; opposite crossing reverses the position.

signal_semantics: Independent per-symbol long/short breakout, no ZigZag or middle-SMA signal.
evaluation_unit: Independent 1m RUB virtual account per symbol.
